name: Building Standards Act (Kenchiku Kijun Ho)
standard: Building Standards Act (Act No. 201 of 1950, as amended)
description: Validates project documentation against the Japanese Building Standards Act (Kenchiku Kijun Ho). Checks building use classification, floor area ratio (yousekiritsu) and building coverage ratio (kenpeiritsu), fire resistance ratings for fireproof / quasi-fireproof structures, structural calculation method classification (Route 1/2/3 or time-history analysis), and confirmation application (kakunin shinsei) documentation requirements.
regulator: MLIT (Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism)
